bull.b: Revenue growth is being supported by measurable commercial expansion: active centers rose from 16 to 21, while the funnel reached 63 and guidance implies 241%–286% 2026 growth. More sites and repeat use can broaden adoption and build a larger recurring revenue base.

An ~84% gross margin, consistent with Q1, indicates attractive economics on current RenovaCath sales. Combined with more than 900 procedures and continued repeat ordering, this supports the potential for customer retention and operating leverage as utilization expands.

Debt-to-equity of about 0.03 and positive equity from 2024 through TTM indicate limited leverage pressure relative to the equity base. This gives RenovoRx more balance-sheet flexibility to fund development and commercial expansion while it works toward profitability.

bear.b: Despite improving revenue, RenovoRx remains deeply unprofitable: TTM net margin is about -622%, net loss is roughly $12.3M, and quarterly operating loss was about $3.4M. Persistent losses can absorb equity and delay self-funded growth.

Operating and free cash flow were both about -$11.9M TTM, while cash fell to $9.5M from $12.4M in one quarter. Continued development and operating burn mean the company still requires external capital before losses narrow materially.

Management's breakeven path depends on reaching roughly $5M in quarterly revenue, converting pipeline and trial sites, and completing remaining TIGeR-PaC events. Delays could push out the targeted Q4 2027 breakeven and H2 2027 topline milestones.
